curriculum.title: Cambridge Primary Science
curriculum.note: The Science framework is not in this class folder on Google Drive, so this map works at strand level. The sub-strands named under each strand, and the five types of scientific enquiry on the Home tab, are the published Cambridge ones. Add the Stage 4 framework and the individual objective codes can be attached lesson by lesson.

objectives.title: Thinking and Working Scientifically. Sub-strands: models and representations; scientific enquiry: purpose and planning; carrying out; and analysis, evaluation and conclusions
Biology. Sub-strands: structure and function; life processes; ecosystems
Chemistry. Sub-strands: materials and their structure; properties of materials; changes to materials
Physics. Sub-strands: forces and energy; light and sound; electricity and magnetism
Earth and Space. Sub-strands: planet Earth; Earth in space; cycles on Earth
Science in Context, connecting science to the learners' own lives, their school and their local environment
Working with data, recording and presenting results in tables and charts

ongoing.title: The five types of scientific enquiry
ongoing.blurb: Cambridge asks that learners meet all five, not only fair testing. Each practical in this plan is one of them; check across a term that all five have been used.

items.title: Finding information from books, the internet and video, and judging it
Changing one thing, keeping the rest the same, and measuring the effect
Taking measurements or observations across days, weeks or a season
Sorting and grouping by observable properties, and using keys
Looking for patterns and relationships in a set of data
